function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT s.period, s.sku, c.channel, SUM(s.revenue_cad) AS revenue_cad, SUM(s.qty) AS qty, SUM(s.revenue_cad)/SUM(s.qty) AS avg_selling_price_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line s
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE s.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY s.period, s.sku, c.channel
ORDER BY s.period, s.sku, c.channel","purpose":"Compute average selling price per unit by SKU and channel for Aug and Sep 2026"}
